clues: This city sits on the west coast of the island land of Sri Lanka. It is that land's largest city by count of folks.
This city is hot all year, but its big rains come in two monsoon spells. One runs from April to June, and the next from September to November.
In 1815, this city was made capital of the whole island. That came when the island was handed to the British Empire.
In 1978, the main work of rule moved out to another city. This city stayed the trade capital of the land all the same.
This city still holds the courts and the top rule posts of the land. It is the money hub of the whole island too.
